name: apple-design-language-web-recipes
description: Verification harness for the web and React Native recipes in skills/apple-design-language/references. Created by Edison Augustin X.

scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare-assets && tsc -p react && tsc -p tailwind && tsc -p react-native && vue-tsc -p vue && svelte-check --workspace svelte --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --threshold warning --fail-on-warnings
scripts.build:next: npm run prepare-assets && next build nextjs && node scripts/check-next.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:next && npm run verify
